product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™Blackbird™ Class 8K60 2x1 Switch With Audio Extraction, HDMI 2.1, HDCP 2.3Share a single 8K60 display between two 8K60 sources while sending audio from either to a separate receiver.The 44435 Blackbird 8K60 HDMI 2x1 Switch allows you to seamlessly switch between two HDMI input signals and output them to a single HDMI display. It supports video resolutions up to 8K60 4:2:0, ensuring stunning visual clarity. With advanced EDID control, the switch prioritizes the desired resolution for optimal performance.This switch also extracts HDMI audio, providing outputs in both analog and digital optical formats for connection to external audio receivers. It supports a wide range of audio formats, including LPCM, Dolby Digital/Plus/Ex, Dolby TrueHD, DTS, DTS-EX, DTS-96/24, DTS High Res, DTS-HD Master Audio, and DSD, making it an ideal choice for high-end home theater and professional AV systems.Versatile and multi-functional, the Blackbird switch is perfect for various applications such as video conferences, multimedia presentations, gaming, and any event requiring the highest resolution and best audio quality on large-screen displays.HDMI 2.1 and HDCP 2.3 compliant48Gbps bandwidth8K60 4:2:0 12 bit, 4K120 4:4:4 12 bitHDR, HDR10, HDR 10+, Dolby Vision, and HDLG pass‑throughLPCM, Dolby Digital/Plus/Ex, Dolby True HD, DTS, DTS-EX, DTS-96/24, DTS High Res, DTS-HD Master Audio, DSDVRR, FVA, and ALLMAdvance EDID managementAudio extraction through analog or digital opticalBuilt in equalizer, retiming and driverIR remote and front panel control TOP TIER PERFORMANCEHandles the ultimate in ultra high definition video, 8K60 4:2:0 12 bit and 4K120 4:4:4 12 bit. SET THE STANDARDHDMI 2.1 and HDCP 2.3 represent the state of the art for video compatibility standards. VIBRANT VIDEOHDR, HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and HLG pass‑through improve video quality for the clearest, crispest possible viewing experience. FURIOUS SOUNDLPCM, Dolby Digital/Plus/Ex, Dolby True HD, DTS, DTS‑EX, DTS‑96/24, DTS High Res, DTS‑HD Master Audio, and DSD put you in the middle of the action. QUICK DRAWVRR, FVA, and ALLM ensure the lowest possible latency and fastest refresh rate possible at any given instant for the best reaction time in gaming. ROCK OUTExtract audio from the HDMI feeds and provide it to your external audio receiver through either analog or digital optical to set the stage for encore‑quality sound. CONTROL FREAKAdvanced EDID management lets you dictate the video resolution selection.
